serverInfo.title: TraceTail
serverInfo.description: TraceTail is a browser fingerprinting API for recognizing returning visitors without cookies. Its JavaScript SDK (a script tag or the npm package @tracetail/js) turns 40+ browser signals into a stable visitor ID with 99.6% accuracy, the same in normal and incognito windows. It works without an API key for a quick start; with a key, every identification is registered with the API, checked for automation and shown in a dashboard. 1,000 identification requests are free every month, then $0.10 per 1,000.
